CREATE TABLE teacher_intervention_inbox (
    event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    analytics_session_id UUID NOT NULL,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    decision_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES teacher_decision(id),
    signal_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('intervene', 'stay_silent')),
    offer_body TEXT,
    dialog_id UUID,
    dialog_message_id UUID,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id) REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id),
    CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (signal_type IN ('student_stuck','student_idle','repeated_failure','progressing')),
    CHECK ((action = 'intervene' AND offer_body IS NOT NULL AND btrim(offer_body) <> '') OR
           (action = 'stay_silent' AND offer_body IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((dialog_id IS NULL) = (dialog_message_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((dialog_id IS NULL) = (delivered_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK (delivered_at IS NULL OR delivered_at >= created_at)
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_intervention_student_session_idx
    ON teacher_intervention_inbox (student_id, analytics_session_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_intervention_one_offer_per_session_idx
    ON teacher_intervention_inbox (student_id, analytics_session_id)
    WHERE action = 'intervene';
